patch_resolves_note: The fixed OpenSC loop keeps the ECC OID copy path but adds the missing `j < SC_MAX_OBJECT_ID_OCTETS` guard, so the protected `oid.value[j] = blob->data[j+1]` write still executes and the last fixed iteration stays at `j = 15` instead of reaching `j = 16`.

relation.description: Source identity relation for the vulnerability-relevant value.

nodes.description: First project-code parser step that turns the attacker-controlled `0x0073` bytes into the split ASN.1 class/tag fields plus payload length used on the crashing path.
Root cause. The loop bound is derived solely from the attacker-controlled blob length, so more than 16 post-algorithm bytes are copied into `oid.value` without any `SC_MAX_OBJECT_ID_OCTETS` check.
ASan crash site. The ECC copy loop writes one 4-byte `int` per OID byte, and the first invalid iteration stores into `oid.value[16]`, beyond the 16-element stack array.

edges.evidence: Vulnerable original: oid_copy_guard.write_index == oid_copy_write.write_index == 16. Fixed original: the last executed in-bounds copy uses 15 at both events.
